title: Decision log
description: The frontmatter of decision-log.md at the specification root (SPEC-001 R9–R10, SPEC-003 R5). Mandatory and non-normative: it constrains nothing; it discloses. One append-only list — each entry records a fact the analysis decided rather than read, locating the file and field it filled so a human can evaluate the decision after the fact. The log is the only place where agent-decided and material-stated are told apart. An empty list is a specification whose material answered everything, and that claim must be true.

entries.unstated: The material does not say what shape an evidence value takes.
entries.why: Every evidence sample in the material is shown as free text.

location.description: The file the decision filled, relative to the specification root. Must resolve.

field.description: The field the decision filled, dotted from the frontmatter root. Its head must exist in the located file.

why.description: Why that value — the claim a reviewer can reject.
